meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: OK Video: hides the join banner and VK ecosystem links, blurs or hides thumbnails and titles, can hide category tabs
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome from outside Russia on https://ok.ru/video with a desktop UA and an iPhone UA (which stayed on the same responsive layout). The page showed the logged-out video showcase with 18 cards. Individual video pages could not be captured (network dropped).

- **Join banner**: `auth-login-banner` 1 (a custom element, text in English in this capture) (LIVE). `auth-login-popup` is the login form itself and is never hidden.
- **VK links**: `.vk-ecosystem-link` 16 (LIVE).
- **Thumbnails**: `img.vid-card_img` and `.video-card .video-card_img-w` 18/22 (LIVE).
- **Titles**: `.video-card .video-card_n` 18 (LIVE). **Categories**: `video-navigation-block` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: video pages, comments, the feed, logged-in pages. Class names are the site's readable BEM-style names (`video-card_n`); custom element names are stable tags.
